title: I need the scissors to cut this paper.
scene: 做手工时他要某样工具。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I need the scissors to cut this paper.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: They are in the drawer, and the blue ones are the ones for you.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I try cutting it all by myself?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can, as long as you sit down while you cut.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'm sitting down now, look at me.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I see you. You can go ahead, but go slow and steady.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Look, I only wobbled the paper twice.
